notification: When did you last feel truly alive?
Call the person you keep avoiding.
Your heart races to its end.
Your favorite song will be unheard.
When did you last say goodbye?
Have you smiled at a stranger today?
How many breaths do you have left?
How will you use this moment?
What if today is your last?

main.text: Life is but a walking shadow, a poor player that struts and frets his hour upon the stage and then is heard no more.
main.author: William Shakespeare
